annotations.title: Turn the LinkedIn manager on or off

description: Turn the user's LinkedIn manager on, pause it, or say what it is set to. On, it runs daily: plans the week from their recent work when there is no plan, drafts the posts in it, checks what went up against it, nudges once on a quiet Thursday, and names people they know who engaged, by email and only when there is something to say. It never posts. Use for 'turn on the LinkedIn manager', 'pause my LinkedIn emails', 'is my LinkedIn manager on'. The same switch is on its card in Agents and on the Scheduled tab.

action.description: turn_on, pause, or status to only read it.
